title: Safe Pro Group Awarded U.S. Army Prime Contract, Teams with Anduril for Super Intelligence on Ghost-X Drone for Tank Protection
summary: AVENTURA, Fla., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Safe Pro Group Inc. (Nasdaq: SPAI) ("Safe Pro" or the "Company"), a provider of super intelligence
body_markdown:
U.S. Government Prime Contract Award Focused on Protecting Army Tanks with Patented SI Powered Threat Detection Onboard Anduril’s Ghost-X Platform


AVENTURA, Fla., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Safe Pro Group Inc. (Nasdaq: SPAI) (“Safe Pro” or the “Company”), a provider of super intelligence (SI)-enabled defense, security, and situational awareness solutions, today announced it has been awarded a milestone U.S. Government Prime Contract award of $2.5 million, focused on protecting the Army’s Abrams Tanks with battle proven SI threat detection and mapping software powering[Anduril Industries’ Ghost-X](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=msLW0_byEjLHehMfjx02_a-WtDLWf11MKf83xhoEiIoUVzxDs8ZfhWckZpSh6VM6-i9BFT0flWQhD4bDGWz4i9Vvc53gqrnWe_6cYPMRpIYIJMehK5zt_bvCIGLi8F1v) drone platform.


The U.S. Army awarded a prime contract under a Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) for Ground Threat Detection through Aerial Reconnaissance that is focused on Safe Pro’s SI tech stack running onboard the Anduril Ghost-X drone, enabling real-time identification and geolocation of more than 150 types of explosive threats, including landmines, anti-personnel mines, cluster munitions, and ambush FPV drones. Safe Pro’s SI is optimized to process live video onboard a drone at the tactical edge, streaming threat data directly into U.S. Army networks including ATAK and[Anduril’s Lattice](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=msLW0_byEjLHehMfjx02_clqCvO2nkWDzASPghbxrvU67E8HCgkr2Xfg2fdv4TPmjVcMsfIt7EDJik7hX1qeFuZcGlMh3Vao4QVcMCq2yil9n29pMOkfLRFgAQqiD_P-) .


The Ghost-X platform has been selected by the U.S. Army for mission-ready intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) applications under its Medium Range Reconnaissance (MRR) program.


“We are honored to be awarded by the U.S. Army our first prime contract, a major milestone for SPAI that reflects our team’s relentless work and dedication to building and fielding our novel SI-powered threat detection and mapping technology,” said Dan Erdberg, chairman and CEO of Safe Pro Group Inc. “We look forward to collaborating with Anduril to deliver our SI on Ghost-X drones to protect those who protect us all.”


“Ghost-X is a highly modular platform that was built to rapidly leverage best-in-class sensing and software technologies,” said Daniel Leighton, General Manager of Tactical Effects at Anduril Industries. “By adding Safe Pro’s threat-detection technology onto Ghost-X, we’re providing soldiers with faster, more reliable situational awareness at the tactical edge – directly supporting the Army’s tank survivability and reconnaissance missions.”


Powered by Safe Pro’s patented Ground Truth software technology, Ground Truth Air, embedded into the compute onboard a drone, uses SI and machine learning algorithms trained on one of the world’s largest real-world drone-based imagery datasets to instantly detect small, hard-to-find threats and objects of interest across large-scale, high-risk environments. Safe Pro’s dataset includes more than 3.2 million drone images and over 60,200 confirmed detections collected across 40,520+ acres in Ukraine. For more information on Safe Pro’s real-world landmine and UXO detection results, visit:[https://safeproai.com/landmine-detections/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=I2UL82AeeOlTvfQsy2VdhLYDhE0zdIirsOu72DxN8NXtp3YZplPG5C6KmyUA1SZ9XuOqZg1DSH8RGpHfp4-sNfnZT8PTnlHXeqZ_4uVadkNELEpipA3RCiReaQn-xxIKabYhqfCyrg4E7s8cJkuXEQ==) .

**About Safe Pro Group Inc.**


Safe Pro Group Inc. (Nasdaq: SPAI) is a mission-driven technology company delivering AI-enabled security and defense solutions. Through cutting-edge platforms like SPAI Ground Truth, Safe Pro provides advanced situational awareness tools for defense, humanitarian, and homeland security applications globally. The Company is a leading provider of super intelligence (SI) solutions specializing in drone imagery processing and mapping, leveraging commercially available off-the-shelf drones with its proprietary machine learning and computer vision technology to enable rapid identification of explosive threats, providing a safer and more efficient alternative to traditional human-based analysis methods. Built on a cloud-based ecosystem and powered by Amazon Web Services (AWS), Safe Pro Group’s scalable platform targets multiple markets, including commercial, government, law enforcement, and humanitarian sectors where its Safe Pro AI software, Safe-Pro USA protective gear, and Airborne Response drone-based services can work in synergy to deliver safety and operational efficiency. For more information on Safe Pro Group Inc., please visit[https://safeprogroup.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=I2UL82AeeOlTvfQsy2VdhANalHsYw-_iFB_hDYJ7NnW9LdIQBk-yJVDgzKwo6KHSC7TtVJa_tpzI7BAD0ercRj-9m4HIJHwlhl44Oz5Uo5A=) .
